limitations: Every capture retains36 unavailable ftrace vendor setup points and attributionComplete=false; no coverage flags or acceptance limits changed.
A requested sampling config is not evidence: actual perf_sample rows/callsites are observed and counted inside each real marker. Unwind-error counts remain visible.
Sampled kernel/emulator hot paths and overlapping nested EGL/HWUI slices do not prove a unique app-level causal regression or handset performance.
This successful diagnostic workflow does not accept or reroll the rejected runtime. All four original failures remain in EXPANSION_RASTER_NATIVE_QA_2026-10-11.json.
observation: Pinch main-thread samples are dominated by goldfish pipe reads/page pinning in QEMU OpenGL submission/synchronization; RenderThread composition is also observed. Actual JS samples are a small subset of the scoped captures. Local-pan has substantial RenderThread Drawing/postAndWait work.
